# Version 4.153.1
> **RAW decoding retirement** · Released September 29, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.153.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.301/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.1 retires built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction.

## Breaking Changes

- **Use an external RAW decoder** — Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode RAW files with an external reader and pass decoded pixels or a supported encoded format to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains value 10 for compatibility but does not indicate codec availability. Standalone JPEG decoding remains available. ([#5187](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5187))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.301

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
